segments.name: Global Business Solutions
segments.description: Serves small and mid-market businesses and accountants worldwide with an all-in-one platform for financial management, payments, capital, payroll, and marketing.
segments.evidence: Global Business Solutions : This segment serves small and mid-market businesses and accountants around the world.

segments.name: Consumer
segments.description: Serves consumers and professional accountants with do-it-yourself and assisted tax preparation, personal finance, and professional tax offerings in the U.S. and Canada.
segments.evidence: Consumer : This segment primarily serves consumers and professional accountants.

revenueModel.text: Consumers and small and mid-market businesses pay Intuit for subscriptions and services such as tax preparation, accounting, payments, payroll, and marketing, and Intuit also earns financing and payment processing revenue.
revenueModel.evidence: We offer financing options for small and mid-market businesses to help them get the capital they need to succeed.

changes.text: In fiscal 2026, Intuit recast prior period segment information, moving certain costs from the Consumer segment to other corporate expenses to conform to the current presentation.
changes.evidence: The recast of prior period information had no impact on our consolidated balance sheets, consolidated income statements, or consolidated cash flow statements.
